## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link public issues or documentation when useful.

## Changes

Describe API, protocol, error handling, concurrency, expiration, resource ownership, and compatibility changes where relevant.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Distinguish local or simulated checks from live service integration, and explain any checks that could not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Public behavior and compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] Relevant build, static checks, and tests pass, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] Changed behavior has appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, tokens, customer configuration, or private endpoints are included.
